items.title: PaperFormalizer: Author-in-the-Loop Autoformalization of Research Papers in Lean
items.author: Jiyuan Tan, Vasilis Syrgkanis, Jose Blanchet
items.description: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version. items.summary: Even a carefully proofread paper can leave small gaps in its proofs or its stated assumptions. We introduce PaperFormalizer, a Lean-based agentic pipeline that helps authors find and close such gaps in their own papers and turn each paper into a Lean-verified version.
